subject: Integration roadmap & eval plan — finalizing MAP actions and close timeline
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@integrateco.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Beth Carter <beth.procurement@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood MAP — next steps for eval and procurement

Camila,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the IntegrateCo team liked the streaming behavior and the cost projection. Procurement (Beth) asked for a simple MAP and evaluation checklist we can use to agree on acceptance criteria and a close timeline.

High level asks from our side:
- A concise list of integration tasks (SDK + API + auth + streaming + tool calls) with owners and rough days to complete
- Eval plan: seed prompts + success metrics for streaming latency and tool calling accuracy
- Target close: end of Q1 (we have an internal budget freeze on 2027-01-15) — can Redwood commit to a pilot SLA and pricing hold through then?

If you can send a one-pager and updated MAP, we’ll review with engineering and procurement tomorrow.

— Alex
Alex Turner | Head of Integrations, IntegrateCo
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@integrateco.com>, Beth Carter <beth.procurement@acme.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 18:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood MAP — next steps for eval and procurement

Alex / Beth — thanks for the clear asks. Attached is a draft MAP (MAP_IntegrateCo_v2.xlsx) and a short eval seed set (eval_seed_prompts.csv). Quick summary and proposed owners below.

Summary of integration tasks (high level):
- SDK integration (init + token lifecycle) — owner: Karthik Iyer — 3 dev days
- API wiring (batching + streaming endpoints) — owner: Camila Reyes — 2 dev days + 1 QA day
- Auth & key rotation (KMS integration, scopes) — owner: Karthik Iyer — 2 dev days
- Streaming performance tuning (latency targets, KV cache policy) — owner: Karthik Iyer — 2 dev days
- Tool calling integration (external webhook handling + retries) — owner: Monica Patel — 2 dev days
- End-to-end eval + acceptance runbook — owner: Camila Reyes / Monica Patel — 2 days

Proposed acceptance criteria (examples):
- Streaming median tail latency < 300ms (95th < 700ms) for 99th percentile request mix
- Tool call success rate >= 98% in 1k/1000 sample runs
- Auth rotation covered by KMS and no manual key changes in test runs

Timeline proposal:
- Kickoff: this Wednesday (2026-12-02) — 30m alignment
- MVP integration + smoke tests: 10 business days after kickoff
- Eval and sign-off window: 3 business days after smoke tests
- Target contract close window: 2027-01-10 to 2027-01-15 (to meet IntegrateCo budget freeze)

Attachments: MAP_IntegrateCo_v2.xlsx (MAP with action rows), eval_seed_prompts.csv (small sample prompts + metrics)

Next step: Can we confirm the kickoff slot? I’ve proposed Wed 11:00–11:30 PT — if that works I’ll send calendar invite and include a short agenda.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@integrateco.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 07:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood MAP — next steps for eval and procurement

Quick technical notes (adding detail to the MAP rows):

- SDK integration: we’ll provide a short sample repo and a minimal auth helper (expires/refresh flow). Expected dev time depends on whether IntegrateCo uses service account or user tokens — if service account, cutover is straightforward.

- Auth & key rotation: we recommend KMS-backed keys. I’ll own a one-page runbook for rotation and a CI check that verifies token expiry handling.

- Streaming: for the eval we should sample both short-chat and long-stream flows. For long streams (>1k tokens) we’ll enable chunked KV caching. I’ll add a KPI column to the MAP spreadsheet with checkpoints for 50th/95th/99th latency by sequence length buckets.

- Tool calling: common failure mode is webhook timeouts when the tool takes >2s. Monica, can you confirm if IntegrateCo’s endpoints support async callbacks (webhook 202 + callback) or only synchronous responses? If only sync, we’ll add retry/backoff in the SDK.

Action items I’ll take now:
1) Add KPI buckets to MAP spreadsheet (due EOD Tue) — Karthik
2) Prepare sample auth runbook (due Thu) — Karthik
3) Share sample SDK repo link in next email — Karthik

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Principal Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@integrateco.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood MAP — next steps for eval and procurement

Thanks — all clear from CS side. A couple procurement/ops notes for Beth:
- We can hold the pilot pricing for IntegrateCo through 2027-01-15 if the MAP is signed by 2026-12-10 and the kickoff happens the week of 2026-12-14.
- Standard pilot SLA (72h support during run) can be upgraded to 24h for an add-on; we’ll note that in the MAP.

From a task perspective I’ll own the tool-calling integration testing and the acceptance run (action item: run 1k sample tool-calls and provide pass/fail report).

Action items recap (owner — due):
- Karthik: KPI buckets + auth runbook + SDK sample repo (EOD 2026-12-01 / Thu)
- Camila: Send calendar invite for kickoff (2026-12-02 11:00 PT) + finalize MAP doc (2026-12-02)
- Monica: Tool-call E2E run and report (target 2026-12-20)
- Alex/Beth: Confirm procurement decision gate dates and availability for kickoff (confirm by 2026-12-02)

I’ll attach the updated MAP after Karthik’s KPI items so we have concrete numbers to review.

— Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
